name: Faces for Radio

evidence.note: Talkhouse describes a high-energy party band known for turning any room into a full party.
Booking profile: party band focused on 80s, 90s, 2000s and current pop-rock; plays NYC, Hamptons, Jersey Shore.
Booking profile calls it a pop/rock/dance cover band; a client review says it was hired as a party band.

dancing.notes: Venue and booking pages call it a high-energy pop, rock and dance party band. Dancing is likely, but we did not watch crowd video.

description: A party cover band formed in 2019 that plays current hits and throwback anthems at bars, clubs and weddings around NYC, Long Island and the Hamptons.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Instagram handle taken from the band's Linktree title (@FacesForRadioNYC); no official website found. Nutty Irishman listing not checked directly.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current Instagram and YouTube kept (Instagram handle is the title of the band's Linktree, linktr.ee/facesforradionyc; Linktree itself is blocked by robots.txt, so its other links could not be checked). Added The Bash profile as the booking link; a GigSalad profile also seems to exist (gigsalad.com/faces_for_radio_washington) but was blocked by a bot check, so not recorded. A Facebook page at facebook.com/facesforradionyc was suggested by a search summary but not verified, so not recorded. No official website. The Bash photos (uploaded by the band) could not be downloaded (HTTP 403), so no images. Current description is fine.

evidence.note: The Bash booking profile: NYC party band (member since 2021) playing 60s-to-today hits, focused on 80s, 90s, 2000s and current pop-rock; says they play NYC, the Hamptons and the Jersey Shore and bring their own sound and lights.
Long Island events listing: Faces For Radio live at The Nutty Irishman, Farmingdale, Sat Oct 3, 2026, 7-10 PM.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: thebash.com, outonthetownli.com, concerts50.com, youtube.com.
